claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r), input T=[x]P0 for the fixed standard BLS12-381 G1 generator P0, recover x. The linear-unit six-class checkpoint rho in proof.md walks on canonical orbits under negation and the GLV endomorphism lambda, where lambda=0xac45a4010001a40200000000ffffffff and lambda^2+lambda+1=r. Multiplying the coefficient pair (a,b) of a+b*lambda by a unit ±lambda^k is one of the six maps with entries in {-1,0,1} proved in proof.md; a step does not perform a CIOS product by lambda. The second conjugate x-coordinate is the field identity beta^2*x=-x-beta*x, so canonicalisation uses one base-field multiplication. Jumps are a table of 2^20 affine points. A point is a checkpoint when bits [20,117) of its canonical x vanish. A repeated checkpoint with independent coefficient pairs solves for x; a dependent repeat abandons the trail and keeps checkpoints already stored. One run always pays S=117165183892697767700873488638206726535 steps, each a batched incomplete affine G1 addition plus 687 scalar instructions, together with table construction, 64 starting points, verification and a 2^30-slot lookup charge. With C=2000 the total is the exact fraction W=314822849119678901812247063973225341738839/2000 target-group-operation equivalents. The submitted score is log2(W) rounded upward at six decimal places. Peak storage is 275046737920 bytes. Preprocessing, included in W, is 26863967764/25. Nonuniform advice is 0 bytes. Success probability is at least 39/100 under the three heuristics named in proof.md. The identity x=0 is the point at infinity and is covered.

experiments.purpose: On a prime-order toy group of bit length bits, with an order-6 multiplication action, check that orbits have size 6 and that a checkpoint collision returns the planted scalar inside the scaled step budget. On the integers, check that the six linear unit maps agree with multiplication by ±lambda^k and that beta^2*x=-x-beta*x. Then, on the production generator only, check phi(P0)=[lambda]P0. The toy check is not a production cost bound and not a measurement of the asymptotic repeat-time constant. The generator check is one finite identity; proof.md extends it to G1 by the endomorphism homomorphism property.
